paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins. The horizontal axis represents the Pass@1 values, while the vertical axis displays the percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with increments of 0.1. The chart features five blue bars, each corresponding to a specific bin: the first bar, labeled at approximately 0.05, reaches 11.2%; the second and third bars, labeled at approximately 0.3 and 0.45, both reach 3.4%; the fourth bar, labeled at approximately 0.65, reaches 5.8%; and the fifth bar, labeled at approximately 0.95, reaches 76.2%. There are no groupings or stacking of bars; the bars are not sorted in a specific order; and no bars are visually emphasized. A red dashed line indicates the mean value of 0.82.
